psnr: R interface to SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl

Source: R/psnr-package.R
psnr-package.Rd

A thin wrapper, through JuliaCall, around the Julia package SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl, which implements the distance-based sampling procedure for cognitive social structures data described in Feltham, Forastiere and Christakis (2025), "Cognitive representations of social networks in isolated villages", Nature Human Behaviour, doi:10.1038/s41562-025-02221-6 .

Details

Julia 1.10 or later and the Julia package are required; see psn_setup(). The main functions are psn_sample() (lists for each perceiver) and psn_inclusion_probs() (exact inclusion probabilities). The method itself is documented with the Julia package: https://human-nature-lab.github.io/SamplingPerceivedNetworks.jl.
